reference.title: Scenario 8 — Image inside a bulleted list item
reference.shortdesc: Consider a section where the author has placed an inline image inside a bulleted list

section.p: Consider a section where the author has placed an inline image inside a bulleted list item, for example, to show an icon or visual indicator as part of a descriptive list.

row.entry: [Heading 2]: Status Indicators [List Bullet]: The green status icon [Inline image]: green_status_icon.png Wrap mode: In Line with Text indicates that the system is running. [List Bullet]: The red status icon [Inline image]: red_status_icon.png Wrap mode: In Line with Text indicates that an error has occurred.

entry.codeblock:
Status Indicators
  • The green status icon indicates that the system is running.
  • The red status icon indicates that an error has occurred.

section.p: Result:The converter maps the bulleted list to <ul> and each bullet item to <li>. Inline images inside each bullet item are preserved as <image placement="inline"/> inside the corresponding <li> element.
